title: The End
author: Zac James
genre: Queer Literary Fiction / Romance / Magical Realism
description: The flare arrives without warning. In the aftermath, the world does not end all at once—it empties.

title: Untitled
author: Philip Schorsch
description: An untitled collection of poetry from Philip Schorsch, exploring the textures of memory, place, and the small rituals that make up a day. Release date to be determined.

title: Chasing Stars
author: Zac James
genre: Queer Literary Fiction / Romance / Magical Realism
description: Running from a life he no longer recognizes, a man finds himself drawn into a love affair as beautiful as it is impossible to hold onto. Chasing Stars is a queer love story about desire, depression, and the people we mistake for destinations and whether some people enter our lives simply to teach us how to keep moving after they are gone.

title: Inevitable Constellations
author: Zac James
description: A collection of poetry about the people we love, the lives we imagine, and the strange inevitability of becoming who we are. Inevitable Constellations traces intimacy, loss, longing, and memory through the quiet connections that only become visible when we look backward—like stars that were always there, waiting for us to draw the lines between them.
